recognize_zh: 四格裡的異常早幼粒細胞（promyelocyte）細胞質塞滿粗顆粒與大量交錯的桿狀 Auer rod，有的核呈雙葉狀，是典型高顆粒型 APL 的樣子。
features: Large abnormal promyelocytes, roughly 2 to 3 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules and numerous crisscrossing rod-like inclusions (multiple Auer rods)
Nuclei round to kidney-shaped, one cell with a bilobed/dumbbell nuclear outline partly obscured by granules
Moderate N:C ratio with granules overlying the nucleus
Background red cells with occasional echinocytes; no normal maturing granulocytes in these crops
describe_en: Composite of four high-power fields shows abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely filled with coarse azurophilic granules and numerous rod-shaped inclusions consistent with multiple Auer rods, arranged in crisscrossing bundles. Nuclei are round to reniform, and one cell shows a bilobed nuclear contour. These cells are morphologically distinct from normal promyelocytes, which lack Auer rods and have a visible Golgi zone. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); urgent confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or PCR and coagulation screening are indicated.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have a perinuclear hof, round nucleus and granules without Auer rod bundles, and show orderly maturation.
Those blasts usually carry a single long slender Auer rod with a salmon-colored perinuclear zone rather than faggots of rods in hypergranular cytoplasm.
Occasional single Auer rods may be present but faggot cells are rare, and PML::RARA is absent.
